title: Advancing automatic photovoltaic defect detection using semi-supervised semantic segmentation of electroluminescence images (PV-S3)
mechanism: Semi-supervised segmentation with a Semi Cross-Entropy loss for class imbalance.
adaptation: Run official code under our split and protocol as a benchmark baseline; test the Semi-CE loss alone inside the house model.
min_experiment: Arm: house + Semi-CE loss. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: crack and inactive IoU. Kill if both < +0.012. Separately run PV-S3 as a benchmark entry.
evidence: R: with 20% labels, +9.7 mIoU, +13.5 precision, +29.15 recall over a fully supervised SOTA on UCF-EL.
prior_overlap: SSL at 100% labels closed (n.d.); Semi-CE loss alone untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Run only as a benchmark baseline under the fixed protocol; mean teacher at 100% labels is closed for raising scores.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark run: PV-S3 code on our splits, 3 seeds, all benchmark metrics; no kill line (reference baseline).

alt_notes.adaptation: For scores, nothing new: it is the SemiCE Mean Teacher line already run here. For the benchmark, run it under our protocol (clean splits, relF1@2, E1) as the only published EL SSL baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark entry only: PV-S3 code on our 478-cell split + pool, 3 seeds, reported with house and PF.
